mailTab.intro: The mail server this deployment sends platform messages through — invitations and other notices. Every transport the build knows is listed; one that needs a package names it.
mailTab.secretOnFile: A credential is on file — type to replace it
mailTab.fromAddressHelp: The address recipients see. Most transports require it to be a verified sender.
mailTab.baseUrlHelp: The address links in a message point at, such as an invitation link.
mailTab.testIntro: Sends through the configured transport, with the same credentials an invitation uses, and records the attempt below.
